Alongside the ongoing discount on M5 MacBook Air at up to $250 off and AirTag 2 from just $17.50 each, Amazon has now updated its giant early Black Friday sale with an even lower price on  AirPods Pro 3  at $70 off and the lowest prices ever on the entire Apple Watch Series 12 lineup starting from $329. These offers include the first chance to save on Apple’s gorgeous Pearl White Ceramic Series 12 and Apple Watch SE 3 starting from just $199 shipped. Check it all out below and go scoop up the 40W Dynamic Power iPhone Duo fast charger while it’s over 25% off. 

Update 11/16: Amazon’s Apple TV 4K discount is now live again for folks looking to scoop one now that it has officially released.

Apple TV 4K

  • NEW Apple TV 4K (4th Generation) $289 (Reg. $299)

Amazon updates early Black Friday sale with loads of new deals: AirPods, Apple Watch Series 12, Fold 8, PlayStation, more

Heads up! AirPods Pro 3 just dropped to one of the lowest prices ever ahead of Black Friday ($70 off)

Amazon’s early Black Friday sale is live with all-time lows on AirTag 2 at $17.50, the now even lower $70 price drop on AirPods Pro 3, and M5 MacBook Air at up to $250 off, but we are also now tracking Apple Watch Series 12 at the best price ever – you’ll now find several configurations at a seriously notable $70 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering AirPods Pro 3 down at $179 shipped. That’s nearly $70 off and one of the lowest prices ever.

Hello! Apple Watch Series 12 just hit the best price ever at $70 off in early Black Friday sale

Amazon is now offering the latest Apple Series 12 models at the lowest price we have tracked since release in September – these deals include the base 42mm and 46mm models, as well as the GPS + Cell variants:

Apple Watch Series 12

  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 42mm: $329 (Reg. $399)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 46mm: $379 (Reg. $449)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm: $429 (Reg. $499)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 46mm: $479 (Reg. $549)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm Titanium: $629 (Reg. $699)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm Titanium w/ Milanese Loop: $679 (Reg. $749)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 46mm Titanium w/ Milanese Loop: $729 (Reg. $799)

You’re looking at deals on the most affordable models starting from $329 shipped to deliver new Amazon all-time lows and the best deals since release. More specifically speaking, the base 42mm GPS-only models are now sitting down at $329 shipped, while the 46mm variants are now starting at $379, down from the regular $449 list price.

Luxurious new Ceramic Apple Watch Series 12 hits best price ever at $70 off (Pearl and Night colors)

Alongside the now even lower price on AirPods Pro 3 at $70, we are also getting some of the first discounts on Apple’s luxurious new Ceramic Apple Watch Series 12 in the gorgeous Pearl White colorway and the super sleek Night Blue.

As mentioned above, you will now find the standard and most popular aluminum Apple Watch Series

  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm Ceramic Pearl White $829 (Reg. $899) – All-time low
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm Ceramic Night Blue $829 (Reg. $899) – All-time low
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm Ceramic Night Blue $879 (Reg. $949) – All-time low

We did catch a lighter deal on the Night Blue models during the fall Prime Day, But this is the very first chance to save on the particularly gorgeous Pearl White model.

Score a current-gen Apple Watch at just $199 in the early Amazon Black Friday sale

  • Apple Watch SE 3 40mm Midnight $199 (Reg. $249)
  • Apple Watch SE 3 40mm Starlight $199 (Reg. $249)
  • Apple Watch SE 3 44mm Midnight $229 (Reg. $279)
  • Apple Watch SE 3 44mm Starlight $229 (Reg. $279)

Don’t need four of them? Single AirTag 2 now down at $23 Amazon all-time low

The Amazon early Black Friday deals are flying and we are catching some seriously great official Apple accessory deals, from nearly 25% off Magic Mouse to a collection of official Apple Watch bands at up to 34% off, and even Apple Magic Trackpad all-time lows. The most notable of which for me, however, has to be the AirTag 2 deals. Not only can you score the 4-pack back at the lowest price ever, but the single listing is now sitting at the $23 Prime shipped all-time low.

Early Black Friday AirTag 2 deals

  • 1-pack AirTag 2 $23 (Reg. $29) – NEW all-time low
  • 4-pack AirTag 2 $70 (Reg. $99) – Matching all-time low

Most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air hits early Black Friday pricing at $250 off today, more

Alongside AirPods Pro 3 down even lower at $70 off and the best prices ever across the Apple Alongside AirPods Pro 3 down even lower at $70 off and the best prices ever across the Apple Watch Series 12 lineup, Amazon has now updated its giant early Black Friday sale with a collection of new discounts and the lowest price in a long while on the most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air. We are still tracking some of the upgraded models within same deep discount and the entry model down at $1,099, but you will now also find the most affordable 15-inch Air at $250 off the list price.

Early Black Friday M5 MacBook Air deals

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,349 (Reg. $1,599) – $250 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,599 (Reg. $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,249 (Reg. $1,499) – $250 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,549 (Reg. $1,799) – $250 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,799 (Reg. $1,999)

While we have started to lose the deals on the higher-end 24GB models in the list above – there is only one color at the deal price on the 13-inch and the 15-inch models have all jumped up, the more affordable end of the lineup is still flying.

The base machine is still at a solid $200 off while the two 16GB/1TB configs remain at $250 off, but you will now find the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and the 512GB SSD down at $1,249.99 shipped.

Apple’s 40W Dynamic Power iPhone Duo fast charger just dropped to $29 at Amazon (Over 25% off)

Alongside the all-time lows now live on Apple Watch Series 12 and the now even lower early Black Friday discount on AirPods Pro 3 (now at one of the lowest prices ever), Amazon has also just dropped the official Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max down to one of its best prices at $29 – this is the model Apple recommends for fast charging on iPhone Duo.

Amazon is now offering the official Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max down at $29 shipped.

This is a regularly $39 charger now at over 25% off the list to deliver the best deal we can find.

We featured a notable discount on this model as the iPhone Duo started to land on door steps across the country at $35, but Amazon has now dropped the price even lower to deliver the best deal we have tracked since the new Apple foldable made landfall.

Over on the Apple support pages, it specifically recommends this model for fast charging iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and the new iPhone Duo.
